fixture_files.test_profile.py:
import unittest
from profile import update_name
from store import Store

class ProfileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_stores_normalized_name(self):
        store = Store()
        self.assertEqual(update_name(store, "u1", "  Alice  "), "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(store.values["u1"], "Alice")

    def test_invalid_update_does_not_overwrite(self):
        store = Store()
        store.put("u1", "Existing")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            update_name(store, "u1", "   ")
        self.assertEqual(store.values["u1"], "Existing")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from account import Account
from ledger import apply_batch

class LedgerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_batch(self):
        account = Account(10)
        self.assertEqual(apply_batch(account, [2, 3]), 15)

    def test_invalid_batch_is_atomic(self):
        account = Account(10)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply_batch(account, [2, -1, 3])
        self.assertEqual(account.balance, 10)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
